_comment: gfxTexture accessors, with both the decompilation in MM2_RE_KIT and the machine code at the
recorded addresses checked against each other.
GetColor (?GetColor@gfxTexture@@QBEIXZ, 0x0045D180) is DELIBERATELY NOT HERE. Its body really is
the four bytes `mov eax, [ecx+0x10] / ret`, but the extent in data/symbols.json runs to 128
bytes and something in .data points at 0x0045D190, inside that range. Build gate 6 rejects it,
and correctly: stripping the recorded extent would delete code that is still referenced. It
becomes portable once the extent is narrowed to the real four bytes, not before.
